messages:
Mira: Quick async — compact check for the Q2 OKR milestone on Model Routing + Rollouts. Please reply with: OWNER | 1-line status (shipped/slipped/at-risk) | next action + ETA. Keep it short so PM can roll this up.

Alex: Alex | shipped (core policy engine v1 canary) | merge PR and enable cost-tier routing in canary -> PR: https://git.redwood/models/pull/2345. ETA: end of week. :tada:

Jordan: Jordan | slipped | canary automation failing under burst (autoscaler race). Next: patch autoscaler + run load repro. ETA: Fri EOD. :frowning:

Lee: Lee | shipped | fallback shim for model-variants is in; unit + integration tests passed. Next: coordinate with infra for staged rollout with canary policy. I'll sync with @Jordan tomorrow AM.

Nina: Nina (product-obs) | at-risk | missing token-level cost breakdown for the new routing matrix — need metric + dashboard tile. Next: add metric + dashboard, then wire to rollouts dashboard. ETA: Wed. Adding perf baseline to PR review checklist.

Sam: Sam (eng-infra) | at-risk -> helping | will take autoscaler fix + dedicated-capacity config once we agree on test seq-lengths. Quick ask: what seq-length distribution should the load test use?

Alex: seq distribution we see in prod: `{"<512": 0.64, "512-2048": 0.30, ">2048": 0.06}` — use those buckets. Also please include a small long-tail burst (x1.5 token rate for 2m) to repro. I'll add to the canary job.

Jordan: FYI logs from canary showed KV-cache thrash: `WARN kv_cache: eviction_rate=0.72, retry_latency_ms=120` — looks like eviction churn under burst. Plan: tune cache TTL + backpressure in the policy layer.

Nina: Quick cross-check: who owns CR review for policy-engine + fallback PRs? Need reviewers before we merge. @Lee @Alex can you pick reviewers?

Lee: I can review tonight for fallback shim and basic rollout docs. Ping me when branch is green. :thumbsup:

Alex: I'll get two reviewers (including @Mira for product sign-off) and update PR checklist to include: token-cost metric, perf baseline, canary runbook.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy kicked: policy-engine v1 -> cluster-canary-2 (start 1862468820). Check logs at https://infra.redwood/canary/1862468820

Mira: Quick summary for PM rollup:
- Shipped: fallback shim (Lee), core policy engine v1 canary (Alex)
- Slipped: canary automation & autoscaler (Jordan) -> infra patch in progress (Sam)
- At-risk: observability tile for token-cost (Nina)
- Immediate next steps: sam to run autoscaler patch + canary with seq-dist, Nina to add metric, Alex to land PR + assign reviewers. ETA sync: Friday rollout decision.

Mira: If anyone needs to escalate deps (security signoff / dedicated capacity budget), reply here and I'll loop in ops. Otherwise I'll roll this up to the OKR doc by EOD Friday. Thanks!
